category_title: Students who use avoidance strategies like pretended reading during silent reading
scenario_title: Silent reading session with avoidance behaviors
minimal_context: The student is expected to read independently and quietly from a book during a silent reading session after the lunch break.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our silent reading session. Please open your books and read independently and quietly.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Whispers in a low voice to a classmate in the corner and keeps turning the pages without stopping to read.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please make sure you are looking at your book.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Swaps books with the classmate, opening a text that has many words and no illustrations.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Are you reading your new book now?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm just going to kind of fake read it. Like, look at the words but don't actually read it.
